verdict.rationale: Otter documents a Public API with API-key auth at api.otter.ai/v1 that retrieves conversations, transcripts, action items, insights and outlines, so scripts can pull the core meeting data. However, it is limited to Enterprise workspaces, and the only documentation is a single prose help article with no spec, interactive reference or sandbox. Missing for 10: evidence that keys are self-serve rather than enterprise-provisioned, an explicit summaries endpoint beyond outlines/insights, machine-readable or in-depth API reference, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my scripts can pull transcripts, summaries, and action items from every meeting through a documented API with self-serve keys

citations.quote: Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
Custom Integrations with Otter's Public API: Otter meeting data connects to any system, including niche CRMs and proprietary platforms
